title: Permutational wreath pullbacks and framed braid-type groups
summary: Let $σ\colon G \to S_n$ be a surjective homomorphism and let $H$ be a group. We introduce the \emph{permutational wreath pullback} \[ H \wr_σG = H^n \rtimes_σG, \] where the action of $G$ on $H^n$ is induced by permutation of coordinates via $σ$, and undertake a systematic structural study of this construction. We determine the center and the abelianization in full generality. We further show that $H \wr_σG$ admits a natural interpretation as the pullback of the classical wreath product $H \wr S_n$ along $σ$, providing a conceptual explanation for its functorial behavior.
